signature_criterion.statement: Reduced alternating diagram D (KnotInfo PD, xtait colour class, all Tait signs +1), crossing c with oriented sign eps(c) and effective resistance R(c) of its edge in the Tait graph (unit resistances): sigma(K_c) - sigma(K) = +2 iff eps=+1 and R<1/2; = -2 iff eps=-1 and R>1/2; = 0 otherwise (KnotInfo signature convention). Also det(K_c) = det(K)*|1-2R(c)| and R_black(c)+R_white(c)=1.

bj_diagram_check: all 5542 KnotInfo diagrams contain at least one crossing whose change lowers u (no diagram-level Bernhard-Jablan failure among alternating knots with known u<=4)
caveats: labels require exact u(K_c); 3439 rows unknown (mostly non-alternating [1,2]/[2,3] results) and are excluded, which biases good-rates upward
603 composite labels rest on a Jones+det identification of the summands (sum-jones); 2059 composite labels are rigorous (block decomposition)
one diagram per knot (KnotInfo PD), no flype orbit
